scope: Phase-scoped formal OpenSpec Verify of cumulative published W01 source plus supplied administrative task/status refresh. No independent PRE/POST, architecture gate, production repair, release, archive, migration or integration verdict.
statusMeaning: PASS in a requirement/scenario row means inspected phase-scoped implementation/control evidence only. It is not requirement acceptance, deployment, production-suite rerun, independent gate approval or completed closure.

taskCompletion.assessment: Administrative task completion is not semantic acceptance. Task3.2 publication is substantiated; actual guide/installed control correctness still fails. Task4.1 remains incomplete until required gaps and fresh Verify are resolved.

correctness.nativeEvidence: 193 passing executions / 177 unique titles, plus separate actual owner replay; audited supplied records, not rerun native product suites.

designAdherence.assessment: Ownership, ordered barriers, exact scopes, immutable supplier and separate future adoption/integration match design. Installed review/role adapters, bootstrap task IDs and original-origin status handling contradict the cumulative executable workflow.

codePatternConsistency.assessment: Common ESM modules, structured BLOCKED errors, branded controller authorities, safe paths and native node:test controls are consistent. Duplicated origin/scope contracts have drifted across adapters; repair the first owning decision rather than weakening validators.

coherence.phaseOrdering: Verify then fresh independent POST then release/adoption decision then archive. Pending future archive/release is not a reason by itself to fail current Verify; V-01–V-04 are.

blockers.title: Installed W01 manifest is rejected by review preparation scope admission
blockers.firstWrongDecision: The review adapter compares each manifest allowed pattern by literal Set membership. Its hard-coded .github/workflows/** does not contain the exact approved .github/workflows/ci.yml entry. The root loader correctly requires the narrower exact entry.
blockers.evidence: Read-only packet import with a complete POST request and unchanged installed manifest returns REVIEW_SOURCE before ownerIdentity, role resolution, canary or dispatch. This is not an unavailable external owner/runtime.
blockers.testGap: Synthetic W01 fixture scopes use the adapter-compatible wildcard; no positive installed-manifest preparation assertion reaches this mismatch.
blockers.recommendation: In an authorized owner repair, reconcile the adapter with the exact approved W01 scope, without widening the manifest or frozen rules. Add an installed-manifest positive preflight and retain widened/foreign scope rejection. Recheck cumulative controls before fresh formal Verify.

blockers.title: Installed role provenance cannot resolve any of the five approved W01 roles
blockers.firstWrongDecision: The installed roleAuthority supplies path/hash/humanDecision but lacks revision and the separately hash-bound decision descriptor required by canonicalSource/verifySource. approvedW01 builds trusted bindings but passes that incomplete manifest through unchanged.
blockers.evidence: Read-only resolveRole calls for planning-architecture, tooling-tests, formal-Verify, independent-PRE and independent-POST all return ROLE_SOURCE. The deliberately non-approving authority callback is never called (0 calls); missing provenance fails before approval, so this probe does not invent approval.
blockers.testGap: The tests construct completed roleAuthority revision/decision descriptors rather than consuming the installed direction.json unchanged.
blockers.recommendation: Reconcile the owning metadata/adapter with the resolver’s authenticated provenance contract while preserving design4, exact pairs and historical admission. Add installed-manifest resolution for all five roles and genuine D03 authority, plus drift/self-approval negatives; do not relax source validation.

blockers.title: Bootstrap generates task IDs that the status parser rejects
blockers.firstWrongDecision: The seed producer emits S01.1–S01.4, while the shared task parser accepts only numeric dotted IDs. Seed rendering passes an empty task string instead of the four generated tasks, concealing the incompatible output.
blockers.evidence: Read-only extraction of all four literal generated checklist lines, passed to the actual projectStatus, yields TASK_MALFORMED and complete/total/remaining = 0/0/0. No new direction, temporary Git owner or product test suite was run here.
blockers.testGap: Parser tests use numeric IDs; bootstrap tests validate creation/retry/scope but do not parse their generated tasks through public status. The guide test exercises invalid arguments only.
blockers.recommendation: Make the seed and parser use the same approved stable-ID contract and derive the initial projection from the actual seeded tasks. Add a real plan/create/check/status chain asserting four tasks and no TASK_MALFORMED; preserve malformed/duplicate-ID rejection.

blockers.title: Historical W01 origin is admitted by check but cannot refresh status with --write
blockers.firstWrongDecision: Status write maintains a separate origin validator requiring both bootstrap intent journals. check explicitly authenticates historical W01 when both are absent. The status path has no corresponding historical-origin admission.
blockers.evidence: Native original-owner replay asserts check VALID and only status preview (no --write). With the installed historical shared-policy/agent-workflow.md path, check’s journal branch would reject; its passing replay therefore exercised historical admission. The write path unconditionally requires the absent journals before freeze handling. This is a source/native-evidence inference; actual original-owner status --write was not run.
blockers.testGap: The W01-named status test creates synthetic bootstrap journals through actualOwner. The new native original-origin test only previews; it does not prove post-unfreeze write viability.
blockers.recommendation: Reuse or coherently implement the authenticated original-origin admission for status writes, retaining owner/source/hash/freeze checks. Add historical W01 write coverage without fabricated bootstrap journals, including frozen deferral and successful refresh after release. Do not create false origin records or modify original approvals.
